probe: What makes being passed over mean that you are not good enough?
premise: Being passed over for a role is a verdict on personal capability and worth.

pairs.reflection: i dont know. they picked someone else so i guess it means they think theyre better than me. and i dont see how thats possible when i put in more hours than anyone
pairs.reply: Leave the hours aside for a moment. When you say they think someone is "better than me", what does that "better" actually mean to you?

pairs.reflection: i dont know what it means exactly. better i guess. like more capable or something. but the guy who got it last time cant even run the weekly planning without asking me how the system works
pairs.reply: If he has to ask you how the system works, what makes his promotion a verdict on who is more capable?

pairs.reflection: i dont know. maybe it isnt about capable then. but i dont know what else it would be about. he just seems to get picked and i dont get why
pairs.reply: We wondered whether underneath this is an assumption that being passed over has to be a verdict on your capability and worth. Does that fit what you feel, or does it not fit?

pairs.reflection: i guess it fits kind of. i mean if its not about being good enough then i dont know what it is and thats almost worse. at least if im not good enough i know what to fix
pairs.reply: "At least if I'm not good enough I know what to fix." What would it mean if this decision wasn't something about you to fix at all?

pairs.reflection: i dont know. that its just out of my hands i guess. which doesnt feel better honestly. then theres nothing i can do about it
pairs.reply: If seeing it as your fault gives you something you can fix, which part of you needs it to be about your worth?

pairs.reflection: i dont really know what you mean by which part of me. its just that i work so hard and it doesnt go anywhere so i have to think its something. i guess im getting tired of going around on this
pairs.reply: We can leave this here. If your hard work isn't a guarantee of being chosen, what is that effort actually for?

event.openQuestion: If your hard work isn't a guarantee of being chosen, what is that effort actually for?
